title: DJ FILTER: master filter after the Electrix FilterFactory
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: A stereo master filter on its own master page (FUNC + LFO, after the stock pages; LEFT / RIGHT step through the master pages), after the Electrix FilterFactory: A the DJ knob (middle off, left low pass, right high pass) or the cutoff, B resonance, C type (DJ, DJ4, LP, LP4, HP, HP4, BP, NTCH; the 4s are 24 dB), D BUZZ drive, E the LFO's wave (TRI, SAW, SQR, RND, or ENV, an envelope follower), F its rate, G its depth (either way), H the effect mix. It filters the whole mix on every output. CLEAR resets it; it starts off. 0.6: the page's code is built smaller (the sound is unchanged), and the knobs are shared as djfilter_kv so other mods can follow the filter. 0.7: SYNC: YES on the page switches the LFO between FREE (RATE in Hz) and SYNC (RATE in note values from 8 bars to 1/32, with dotted and triplet ones), locked to the sequencer's steps.
